name: pipes-rs
summary: Rust rewrite of pipes.sh, cross-platform (the Windows choice). ANSI mode uses the terminal palette; optional TOML config for pipe kinds, count and speed.

install.notes: extras bucket: run `scoop bucket add extras` first. The scoop manifest lists Apache-2.0; the upstream LICENSE.md is Blue Oak 1.0.0.

windows.notes: The README gives ~/.config/pipes-rs/config.toml for every OS; whether Windows reads %USERPROFILE%\.config or %APPDATA% was not checked. On Windows pass flags in the pane command instead of relying on the file.

install.notes: Third-party tap maintained by the author, not homebrew-core.
README method: `cargo install --git https://github.com/lhvy/pipes-rs`. The crates.io name pipes-rs is a different, old crate (0.1.1): do not `cargo install pipes-rs`.
Arch: AUR (pipes-rs or pipes-rs-bin). No apt or dnf package found on Repology.

theme.notes: -c ansi follows the terminal palette; rgb mode uses built-in hue palettes, not the look palette.

config.notes: Pipe kinds, count, delay, turn chance; flags or config.toml.
